name: Finance Agent v1.1
description: Finance Agent Benchmark (FAB) v1.1 evaluates LLM agents on real-world financial research tasks mirroring junior-analyst workflows. Each task supplies a natural-language research question and a realistic financial context (filings, earnings transcripts, market data, company profiles); the agent must plan, retrieve evidence, perform quantitative analysis, and deliver a grounded answer. v1.1 refines task selection, grader rubrics, and data snapshots relative to the initial Vals AI release so scores more faithfully separate genuine financial reasoning from retrieval luck.
typical_sota_score: ~45–60% (frontier agents on v1.1 as of late 2025)
reputation: Published and maintained by Vals AI; canonical public leaderboard for financial-research agents as of 2025; paper on arXiv (2508.00828); cited in frontier-model agent evaluations
notes: v1.1 released 2025 as update to initial Finance Agent Benchmark (FAB). Tasks span equity research, credit analysis, macro lookup, earnings-transcript comprehension, filings-based quantitative questions, and multi-source financial reasoning. Designed to require tool use (calculator, search, document readers) rather than closed-book recall. Graders combine automated exact-match on numerical answers with rubric-based judgment for open-ended justifications.
